study_identification_part.si4_title: Brain-Charting Autism and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Reveals Distinct and Overlapping Neurobiology

answer: HBN (Healthy Brain Network) at the Child Mind Institute
Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD dataset
UK MRC-AIMS (Medical Research Council Autism Imaging Multi-centre Study)
University of California San Diego (UCSD) Biomarkers of Autism study
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study leveraged the BrainChart reference models (based on ~75k individuals) and applied them to a combined clinical dataset from 7 sources (ABIDE, POND, HBN, ADHD200, Female ASD, UK MRC-AIMS, UCSD).
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Here, we leveraged models of average brain development previously characterized by our group (98)... using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals... T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets, including the ABIDE... POND... HBN... ADHD200... the Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD dataset... UK MRC-AIMS... and the University of California San Diego Biomarkers of Autism study."
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Sample and Datasets, Paragraph 1; Introduction, Paragraph 5

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The BrainChart models were used as the normative reference. The clinical datasets (ABIDE, POND, etc.) were used to generate out-of-sample centile scores to characterize alterations in autism and ADHD.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Here, we leveraged models of average brain development previously characterized by our group (98) to quantify alterations related to autism and ADHD... Out-of-sample estimates for the study sample used here were generated based on these reference models"
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Introduction, Paragraph 6; Methods and Materials / Generation of Centile Scores..., Paragraph 1

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: The normative model used was the pre-existing BrainChart model based on 75,241 individuals. The study's own healthy control group (N=1869) was used for benchmarking and comparison with clinical groups, not for constructing the normative model itself.
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals... Out-of-sample estimates for the study sample used here were generated based on these reference models"
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Generation of Centile Scores..., Paragraph 1

dc4_age_info.detail: Specific age statistics for the 75,241 normative reference subjects are not provided in this paper, only described as 'across the life span'. The study's control group (N=1869) had Mean Age 15.0 (SD 7.9).
dc4_age_info.supporting_text: "map neuroanatomical developmental trajectories across the life span, using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals... The final dataset after quality control (QC) included 4255 individuals (1869 typically developing control participants... ages 2 -64 years [mean 14.0, median 12.4])"; Table S1.2.5: "TD ... Age, mean (sd): 15.0 (7.9)"

dc5_sex_info.detail: Sex distribution for the 75,241 normative reference subjects is not provided in this paper. The study's control group (N=1869) included 687 females (36.8%) and 1182 males.
